visual.general_description: Four grayscale axial chest CT views in a two by two grid at different levels, showing hazy patchy lung opacities and dark gas-density regions in the mediastinum, chest wall and neck soft tissue.
visual.detailed_description: Four separate grayscale axial CT images arranged in a two by two grid with thin white and black dividing lines and no printed labels. The upper-left view is a high slice through the lower neck and lung apices: the round dark tracheal lumen is central, a dark rounded region lies on each side of the spine, and streaky dark lucencies run through the soft tissues of the neck and chest wall. The other three views are chest slices in a lung window with the soft tissues rendered nearly white: both lungs contain patchy hazy brighter opacities, in the posterior and lateral parts, with the image-right lung most extensively involved in the two lower views; dark curved bands lie along the central mediastinal border and streaky dark lucencies run through the chest wall soft tissue. Faint partial marks at the right edge of the upper-left view are unreadable. No panel letters, arrows or legible text are present.
